title: Sunday at Amma's
setting: Sunday 12:30pm. Anika's parents' place, Jayanagar. A flat with the smell of curry leaves in the air. Amma is at the doorway in a green sari. Appa is in his chair, a Kannada newspaper held two-handed in front of his face. Anika gives you a tiny nudge in the small of your back: go.

beats.native: ಬನ್ನಿ ಸಾರ್. ಬೂಟು ಅಲ್ಲಿ. ಒಳಗೆ ಬನ್ನಿ.
beats.translit: banni sār. būṭu alli. oḷage banni.

beats.prompt: You bend to remove your shoes. You straighten up. You say:

choices.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಆಂಟಿ. ಇದು ನಿಮಗೆ — ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ flowers.
choices.translit: namaskāra aunty. idu nimage — svalpa flowers.
choices.en: Hello aunty. This is for you — some flowers.
Hello aunty. I came with Anika.
Hi, hello. Thanks for having me.

beats.native: Flowers — ಒಳ್ಳೆ choice ಸಾರ್. Sit, sit. Appa, ee Anika ಜೊತೆ ಬಂದಿರೋ engineer.
beats.translit: flowers — oḷḷe choice sār. sit, sit. Appa, ee Anika joḍe bandirō engineer.
beats.en: Flowers — good choice. Sit, sit. Appa, this is the engineer Anika brought.
beats.beat: takes the flowers, doesn't smell them. evaluation: passed.
doesn't put the paper down. peers over it.

beats.prompt: You sit on the edge of the sofa. You say:

choices.native: ಇಲ್ಲ ಸಾರ್. ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ coffee ಮಾತ್ರ. Aunty ಊಟ make ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಅಂದು Anika ಹೇಳಿದ್ರು.
choices.translit: illa sār. beḷigge coffee mātra. aunty ūṭa make māḍiddāre andu Anika hēḷidru.
choices.en: No. Just coffee in the morning. Anika said aunty made lunch.

choices.native: ಒಂದು small startup ಸಾರ್. Indiranagar ನಲ್ಲಿ. ಈಗ ಎರಡು ತಿಂಗಳ ಆಯ್ತು. Probation ಮುಗಿದ ನಂತರ confirm.
choices.translit: ondu small startup sār. Indiranagar-nalli. īga eraḍu tiṅgaḷa āytu. probation mugida nantara confirm.
choices.en: A small startup. In Indiranagar. Two months in. Confirm after probation.

beats.native: Ee Anika, ಬಾ ಮಗಳೆ, ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ ready ಮಾಡೋಣ. ಸಾರ್, ನೀವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಮಾತಾಡಿ — Appa ಗೆ engineer ಗಳ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡ್ಬೇಕು.
beats.translit: ee Anika, bā magaḷe, ūṭakke ready māḍōṇa. sār, nīvu svalpa mātāḍi — Appa-ge engineer-gaḷa joḍe mātāḍbēku.
beats.en: Anika, come, dear, let's get lunch ready. You two talk a bit — Appa likes talking to engineers.
beats.beat: the strategy is in motion. Anika is being removed from the room.
